name: Itoshi no☆My Master
source:
Once there lived a normal madam and maid in a village.
They were perfectly normal.
Normal life, normal relationship, but kind of abnormal.
This is how things changed.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126978.html]DLsite English[/url]]

Based on a [url=http://natukon.mints.ne.jp/mrs/mrs.cgi]series of short stories[/url] by the circle.
translation:
从前，村里住着一位普通夫人和一名普通女仆。

她们过着完全普通的生活。
普通的日子、普通的关系，却又有些不寻常。
事情就是这样发生改变的。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126978.html]DLsite English[/url]]

改编自该社团创作的[url=http://natukon.mints.ne.jp/mrs/mrs.cgi]短篇小说系列[/url]。
